description: Create a certification study planner spreadsheet. Set up a header with exam date (8 weeks from today using =TODAY()+56) and countdown (=B2-TODAY()). Create a table with columns: Week, Knowledge Area, Study Hours, Practice Questions, Completed, Priority. Add 8 weeks of study data covering different topics. Add summary calculations: Total Study Hours (SUM), Total Practice Questions (SUM), Weeks Completed (COUNTIF), and Completion Percentage. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
